citations.S1: SQL injection — critical.** `user_id` and `status` come from the request and are interpolated into the query string.
citations.S2: Connection is never closed — high.** No `close()`, no context manager, and an exception in `execute` leaks it outright.
citations.S3: `TypeError` on every call — critical.** `order[0]` is an integer id from the database, and `"Order #" + 1` raises `TypeError`
citations.S5: Money accumulated in binary floats — high.** `0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3`.
citations.S6: `pct` is not range-checked — high.** `pct=150` returns a negative price
citations.S7: `status` is not checked against an allowlist — medium.
citations.S8: No authorization on the object — critical.** `user_id` is taken from the request, so any authenticated caller can read any other customer's orders
citations.S9: A NULL amount raises a bare `TypeError` — medium.** `None` in the `amount` column
citations.S10: Money rendered with `str()` — high.** `str(10.5)` is `"10.5"`, not `"10.50"`
citations.S11: Raw `sqlite3` errors reach the HTTP handler — medium.
citations.S13: Unbounded result set — medium.** `fetchall` with no `LIMIT`
citations.S14: Rows come back as positional tuples — medium.** ... Fix: `sqlite3.Row` plus a small frozen dataclass.
